about_the_game:
Mechjestic is a steampunk inspired Deck Building Card Game RPG. With our unique systems of Mech building and the Refuel mechanic, this Deckbuilder gives players a lot of freedom to play their cards how they see fit and make every turn count. There is never one way to finish a fight, and Mechjestic gives players the option to find their favorite strategies!


The player controls Frolein and her personal Mech; Iron Tadpole.

Mechjestic - Demo Version gives you a glimpse of the many possibilites the game will have to offer. What strategies will you implement to overcome the evil Timeless Machines? Battle through the Overworld, gear up with your rewarded cards and make your way towards the menacing final obstacle called; Jawlock!

Unique Features

  • Visual Mech Building : By gathering and building your deck with Equipment cards, you can use these cards to visually change the Mech and its attributes to your liking. Combine all five limbs from one specific Mech Set and you will receive special Set Bonus! Maybe try playing the Demo again? Who knows what Deck you will have the second try!


  • Refuel Mechanic : Playing cards or upgrading your Engine requires the use of Fuel. With Mechjestic you have the freedom to spend Fuel that you have accumulated or Refuel the cards you have to obtain more Fuel to use during your turn. This flexible system allows the player a lot of freedom in how they structure and play their Decks.
    Even the Deckbuilder is based on the maximum Fuel capacity instead of a hard Card limit! (Minimum of 10 cards in the Deck.)


  • Overworld Mechanics : The player goes through an Overworld, specially made for this Demo, to find the Final Boss. This happens in a puzzle style in which the player carefully thinks about where they go. With a 'fog of war' plagueing the area around you, it will not be an easy task to find find some amazing treasure and find your way to challenge Jawlock!


What is this strange set? Make sure to find out!

short_description: Build the DECK - Craft your MECH! With this unique take on deckbuilding, you visually build parts of the mech that help you win the battle. Tired of unlucky draws? Sacrifice cards in your hand with our special Refuel system and use that Fuel to play cards you need at crucial moments!
